note: The MuJoCo bases of the RoboTangle release and how their instances are made: input of tools/release/release_rebuild.py (the final release rebuild, docs/history/MUJOCO_MIGRATION.md). A family's base <family>-<tier><from> (the released Genesis base) becomes <family>-<NN><to>, NN its number in the family's numbers (a tier without one keeps <family>-<tier><to>; PROTOCOL §2.8: changed physics makes a new task). Task names carry no difficulty: release.json keeps the tier, task.toml states difficulty. Its instance is made inside the release image: rcb_topogym.py make-instance --task <family> --variation <variation> --scene-seed <scene_seed> --gripper-space <gripper_space> [--simulator-overrides <file>], with the MuJoCo tasks' numpy / OpenBLAS SIMD masking. variation: <family>_<tier> unless the family's variations map names it. The overrides: released_simulator_keys copies those keys of the released instance's simulator configuration (the base image's /opt/robotangle/instances/<released base>/instance.json); simulator_overrides adds fixed values, in which "@released_instance" stands for that instance.json's path and "@render_host/<path>" for a file of the render host. A family's make_instance overrides the defaults (gripper_space). The ports of released IPC ropes (rope agent's port_instance.py): render_host copies the released instance and its task's runtime_binding.json into instance_assets/render_host/ (the render host and the birth source; the instance records mujoco_birth relative to itself, and ported_from); frozen_assets copies the released frozen generated assets and installs them before the Session, so declare() uses the released tet volume, not this CPU's tetgen; released_task_parameters passes the released simulator.task_parameters; grasp_weld_links makes the assisted grasp contact_weld_v1 on every link of the entity (link_m long, the released tolerances). Each base needs its MuJoCo reference, oracles/<new base>/privileged.npz in the tree or release_rebuild.py --references <dir>; its birth must be the one the reference recorded (instance_sha). A family's package_text (a directory of the tree) holds task texts laid over the released ones, file by file: <package_text>/<released base>-<mode>/ for its tiers (a design changed under the released variation id), <package_text>/<new base>-<mode>/ for its new bases; its design (one line, what changed) goes into the README's change log. new_bases {<new base>: {template, variation, tier, task, scene_seed, gripper_space, package_text, design, simulator_overrides}} are tasks of a new design under new names (template and variation required; tier defaults to the variation without <family>_, task to the family, the rest to the family's): a new base takes its template's released texts (a released base, which stays as it is) under the new name with its own texts over them, its instance is made like a tier's but without the released-instance overrides (its own simulator_overrides, fixed values, apply), its reference is oracles/<new base>/privileged.npz, and release.json records it with its template instead of replaces. tiers may be empty.
gpu_profiles_note: MuJoCo profiles whose physics needs a GPU (the blanket's CUDA cloth step): a base whose simulator_overrides name one is made with a GPU (release_rebuild.py --gpu), its release.json record says gpu_physics, its tasks keep the one-GPU reservation for physics as well as Nyx, and its Harbor checks keep the GPU with rendering off.
